cases.name: entering implement-tdd writes ultra and saves the mode that was in force
cases.cmd: D={{FIX}}/cfg-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $D; printf lite > $D/.caveman-active; printf '{"tool_name":"Skill","tool_input":{"skill":"implement-tdd"}}' | CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$D bash .claude/hooks/caveman-skill-ultra.sh; printf '%s|%s' "$(cat $D/.caveman-active)" "$(cat $D/.caveman-active.before-skill)"

cases.name: a second code skill in the same run keeps the first saved mode
cases.cmd: D={{FIX}}/cfg-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $D; printf lite > $D/.caveman-active; for s in plan-implementation implement-tdd; do printf '{"tool_name":"Skill","tool_input":{"skill":"'$s'"}}' | CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$D bash .claude/hooks/caveman-skill-ultra.sh; done; printf '%s|%s' "$(cat $D/.caveman-active)" "$(cat $D/.caveman-active.before-skill)"

cases.name: another skill leaves the flag alone
cases.cmd: D={{FIX}}/cfg-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $D; printf lite > $D/.caveman-active; printf '{"tool_name":"Skill","tool_input":{"skill":"bulk-read"}}' | CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$D bash .claude/hooks/caveman-skill-ultra.sh; printf '%s|%s' "$(cat $D/.caveman-active)" "$(cat $D/.caveman-active.before-skill 2>/dev/null)"

cases.name: the next session start restores the saved mode and drops the sidecar
cases.cmd: D={{FIX}}/cfg-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $D; printf lite > $D/.caveman-active; printf '{"tool_name":"Skill","tool_input":{"skill":"implement-tdd"}}' | CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$D bash .claude/hooks/caveman-skill-ultra.sh; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$D bash .claude/hooks/session-cleanup.sh; printf '%s|%s' "$(cat $D/.caveman-active)" "$(ls $D/.caveman-active.before-skill 2>/dev/null)"

cases.name: a mode the user switched by hand in between is left alone
cases.cmd: D={{FIX}}/cfg-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $D; printf lite > $D/.caveman-active; printf '{"tool_name":"Skill","tool_input":{"skill":"implement-tdd"}}' | CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$D bash .claude/hooks/caveman-skill-ultra.sh; printf full > $D/.caveman-active; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$D bash .claude/hooks/session-cleanup.sh; printf '%s|%s' "$(cat $D/.caveman-active)" "$(ls $D/.caveman-active.before-skill 2>/dev/null)"

cases.name: no flag before the skill: the plugin default comes back by removing the file
cases.cmd: D={{FIX}}/cfg-{{SID}}; mkdir -p $D; printf '{"tool_name":"Skill","tool_input":{"skill":"tests-unit-tests"}}' | CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$D bash .claude/hooks/caveman-skill-ultra.sh; printf '{"session_id":"{{SID}}"}' | CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$D bash .claude/hooks/session-cleanup.sh; printf 'flag=<%s>' "$(cat $D/.caveman-active 2>/dev/null)"
